entities.name: Brevinin-1SPc (P0DQK1)
observations: The 24-aa input sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Brevinin-1SPc from Lithobates septentrionalis (100% identity and coverage; E-value 1.35e-08).
UniProt annotation describes antimicrobial activity against Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria and fungi; hemolytic activity is also reported; localization is secreted.
Sequence-derived properties: 24 aa, predicted pI 9.851, GRAVY 1.25, estimated unmodified mass 2585.265 Da; Pfam Antimicrobial_1 (PF08018.17) spans residues 1–24.
Likely processes include antimicrobial defense/host defense; hemolytic activity is a reported additional in-vitro property, not itself a biological process assignment.
